g.text: XIAO ESP32-C3 (22-pad OPL symbol). Native USB stays on the module.

g.desc: XIAO ESP32-C3 (22-pad OPL symbol). Native USB stays on the module.

g.text: Pad 14 VUSB is tied directly to +5V; pad 21 VBAT is unused.

g.desc: Pad 14 VUSB is tied directly to +5V; pad 21 VBAT is unused.

g.text: Appliance pin 1 / pin 3 selection is automatic (U9/U10 load switches, D14/D15 blocking); D1/D2/D3 are input ESD clamps.

g.desc: Appliance pin 1 / pin 3 selection is automatic (U9/U10 load switches, D14/D15 blocking); D1/D2/D3 are input ESD clamps.

g.text: U8 AP63205 buck output BUCK_5V reaches the +5V rail through D11, which blocks backfeed into the buck.

g.desc: U8 AP63205 buck output BUCK_5V reaches the +5V rail through D11, which blocks backfeed into the buck.

g.text: XIAO pad 14 VUSB is the module native USB VBUS net and sits directly on +5V; the only fuse is inside the module, downstream of pad 14. XIAO pad 21 VBAT is unused.

g.desc: XIAO pad 14 VUSB is the module native USB VBUS net and sits directly on +5V; the only fuse is inside the module, downstream of pad 14. XIAO pad 21 VBAT is unused.

g.text: J2 is a permanent recovery header: regulated 5V in through D19, 3.3V logic. Use it only with USB and the appliance physically disconnected.

g.desc: J2 is a permanent recovery header: regulated 5V in through D19, 3.3V logic. Use it only with USB and the appliance physically disconnected.

g.text: CONNECT ONLY ONE SUPPLY AT A TIME. With the appliance powered the USB connector VBUS is energised; simultaneous sources are not protected.

g.desc: CONNECT ONLY ONE SUPPLY AT A TIME. With the appliance powered the USB connector VBUS is energised; simultaneous sources are not protected.

g.text: U9/U10 TPS1H200: FAULT NC, DIAG_EN and exposed pad GND; DELAY via 100k to own VS. CL 3.3k = provisional 0.606 A. Retry 35-45 ms on / 0.8-1.2 s off; bench qualification required. DNP = do not populate; test points and mounting holes are not assembled components.

g.desc: U9/U10 TPS1H200: FAULT NC, DIAG_EN and exposed pad GND; DELAY via 100k to own VS. CL 3.3k = provisional 0.606 A. Retry 35-45 ms on / 0.8-1.2 s off; bench qualification required. DNP = do not populate; test points and mounting holes are not assembled components.

g.text: 6 RECOVERY HEADER J2 (5V IN VIA D19) / DEBUG HEADER J3
